This inspiring concert honors the values of stewardship, respect for nature, and caring for future generations through music that celebrates Native American artists. Blending powerful choral performances with a message of hope and connection, the program reflects on the gifts we’ve inherited and the responsibility we share to preserve them. Join Chorus Eclectic for an uplifting musical tribute to the past, present, and future.

events.title: Music lessons with Pleasanton's 1776-era fife and drum children's band
events.description: Do you want your child (8-16) to experience the fun, education and social camaraderie of being in the marching band---but without the enormous time commitment of a school marching band? Look no further! We have been providing music and leadership education to Pleasanton-area kids since our first lesson on March 19th 2010. The Young American Patriots Fife & Drum Corps "YAPs" is a NON-POLITICAL children's parade band dedicated to perpetuating the music, history & heritage of our nation's founding through musical education & traditional value-based teaching. We teach fife (like a flute) and drum in a small group setting.

events.description: Do you want your child (8-16) to experience the fun, education and social camaraderie of being in the marching band---but without the enormous time commitment of a school marching band? Look no further! We have been providing music and leadership education to Pleasanton-area kids since our first lesson on March 19th 2010. The Young American Patriots Fife & Drum Corps "YAPs" is a NON-POLITICAL children's parade band dedicated to perpetuating the music, history & heritage of our nation's founding through musical education & traditional value-based teaching. We teach fife (like a flute) and drum in a small group setting.

events.title: Mads Tolling’s Cool Yule: A Nordic Holiday Celebration
events.description: In the spirit of Yule, two-time Grammy Award winner Mads Tolling shares the Christmas celebrations of his youth in Copenhagen, blending the authentic customs and sounds of the Nordic countries with the joy and spirit of American jazz. Cool Yule celebrates the magic of the season with a special tribute to Denmark’s Hans Christian Andersen, featuring a medley of songs from Frozen and other fables. The concert also honors Nordic holiday traditions with a salute to Julemanden (Santa Claus) and festive Yuletide classics. Enjoy jazz-infused arrangements of American holiday favorites, including “Santa Baby,” “My Favorite Things,” “The Christmas Song,” and more. Learn more at madstolling.com/cool-yule/ .

Adult volunteers assist students with homework or practice with reading and math. 3-5 p.m., Mon., Tues., Thurs. 2-4 p.m., Wed. Through May 13 excluding holidays.

events.title: Free Social Adults-Only (19+) Chess Club
events.description: Our weekly casual chess nights are aimed at adults (19+) of all levels, including: - passionate online players looking to connect and compete in person - chess parents that want to keep up with their kids - novices that are curious about the game - come between 5:30-6:30 PM to get instruction and tips! We welcome women and seniors! - current and returning tournament players. Join us if you are looking for a non-intimidating way to exercise your brain, hang with other adults, and maybe even win a prize! Organizer: Emerald Hills Chess is a Dublin nonprofit that teaches 300 K-12 students in the Tri-Valley, and also holds popular (100-150 player) US Chess-rated monthly tournaments.
events.venue: Pacific Pearl Mall Food Hall (next to Shihlin Taiwan Street Food Snacks)

events.title: Anand Varma: Exploring Nature's Hidden Worlds
Music lessons with Pleasanton's 1776-era fife and drum children's band
events.description: Do you want your child (8-16) to experience the fun, education and social camaraderie of being in the marching band---but without the enormous time commitment of a school marching band? Look no further! We have been providing music and leadership education to Pleasanton-area kids since our first lesson on March 19th 2010. The Young American Patriots Fife & Drum Corps "YAPs" is a NON-POLITICAL children's parade band dedicated to perpetuating the music, history & heritage of our nation's founding through musical education & traditional value-based teaching. We teach fife (like a flute) and drum in a small group setting.
events.venue: near Mohr Elementary school, call for details
